title: Tier columns can mix % Off, + $, Margin % and Markup %
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, one range, Default 50% markup, tier A 10% off, tier B Cost + $5, tier C 30% margin.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Type 100 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Default reads 50% markup, tier A 10% off, tier B Cost + $5 and tier C 30% margin, side by side.

Step 3:

  • Default shows $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50) and tier A $135.00 ($150.00 × 0.90).
  • Tier B shows $105.00 ($100.00 + $5.00).
  • Tier C shows $142.86 ($100.00 ÷ (1 − 0.30), rounded to the cent).
